The anchor day is saved into the template the first time. Any error rolls back that one template and the loop continues with the rest.

sections.title: Scheduling
sections.explanation: `startRecurringCron` is idempotent through the module-level `task`. It schedules `5 0 * * *` and wraps `runRecurring` in `withCronLock('recurring', ...)`, catching errors so a failed run never crashes the process. `runRecurring` is also exported for the Finance 'run now' endpoint.

server/utils/cronLock.js.overview: A small single-flight guard for scheduled jobs. During a rolling deploy two server instances run at once, so without it both would fire the same cron and send reminders or digests twice. It uses a Postgres session-level advisory lock held on one pooled connection for the length of the job. Tour step 11 introduces it.

sections.title: Rationale and namespace
sections.explanation: The comment explains the problem, how to use it, and the failure policy: if the lock itself cannot be taken (database down, pool exhausted), the job runs unguarded, because a missed reminder is judged worse than a small double-send risk. `LOCK_NAMESPACE = 7100` is chosen to avoid the `7001` key the invoice routes already use.

sections.title: Taking the lock
sections.explanation: `withCronLock(name, fn)` checks out one connection and calls `pg_try_advisory_lock(namespace, hashtext(name))`, which returns immediately instead of waiting. If the query fails, the connection is destroyed and `fn` runs anyway. If another instance holds the lock, the connection is released and the function returns `undefined` without running the job. The pool can be injected for tests.

sections.title: Running and releasing
sections.explanation: The job runs inside try/finally. Afterwards it unlocks explicitly; if the unlock fails, the connection is released with `true`, which destroys it, so a session still holding the lock never returns to the pool. Postgres frees the lock when that session ends. Because it is a session lock rather than a transaction lock, the job is free to run its own transactions on other connections.

server/routes/finance.js.overview: The Finance tool's Express router, one of the largest files in the project with over a hundred endpoints. It covers settings, chart of accounts, clients, suppliers, invoices and quotes, expenses and receipts, home office and vehicle calculators, wages, drawings, an asset register with depreciation, recurring entries, the journal, BAS quarters, dashboards and reports. Shared accounting helpers (GST, journal posting, workspace date) are defined here and exported on the router object for `recurringCron.js` and other modules. Tour step 11 points to it as the consumer of the recurring job.

sections.title: Imports, logo and receipt uploads
sections.explanation: Sets up Express, multer and file paths. The company logo is read once at startup into a data URI for inline email embedding; if it is missing, emails render without it. `receiptUpload` stores receipts on disk under unique names, with a 5 MB limit and a filter allowing only common image types and PDF.

sections.title: Workspace timezone and today
sections.explanation: `getWorkspaceTimezone` reads the first admin's `user_timezone` setting, defaulting to Australia/Sydney. `todayStr` formats today in that zone with the `en-CA` locale, which yields `YYYY-MM-DD`. The comment explains why: UTC would date morning entries in Brisbane as yesterday and could put them in the wrong BAS quarter.

sections.title: Accounting helpers
sections.explanation: Invoice numbering, GST registration (with a recorded date from which GST stops applying), GST basis SQL fragments, account and transaction-code seeding, and journal helpers. `createJournalEntry` refuses any entry whose debits and credits differ by half a cent or more, a final safeguard so no caller can write unbalanced books. `lockedQuarter` blocks changes to records dated inside a reconciled or lodged BAS quarter.

sections.title: Settings, accounts, clients, suppliers, codes
sections.explanation: CRUD endpoints for finance settings (business details, bank details, GST options), the chart of accounts, clients, suppliers and transaction codes, each scoped to the signed-in user via `req.user.id`.

sections.title: Invoices, quotes and reminders
sections.explanation: `SETTABLE_STATUSES` deliberately leaves out `paid`: an invoice is only paid through the mark-paid endpoint, which also posts the payment journal. `postInvoiceJournal` replaces any existing journal for an invoice with debit Accounts Receivable, credit Income, credit GST Collected. The section then covers invoice and quote listing, editing, sending and the manual trigger for finance reminders.

sections.title: Expenses, receipts, home office, wages, drawings
sections.explanation: Expense creation goes through `createExpenseRecord` so the insert and its journal always match; it is also exported for bulk creation from the invoice review queue. Following sections handle receipt files, home-office evidence and a daily work-from-home hours log (records only, no journal), wages and owner's drawings.

sections.title: Calculators, trip diary and assets
sections.explanation: Vehicle and home-office deduction calculators with a per-year method stored in settings, a vehicle trip diary, and the asset register. `computeAssetYearDepreciation` and the low-value pool election calculate depreciation per financial year using inclusive day counts and cent rounding.

sections.title: Recurring templates
sections.explanation: Simple CRUD over `fin_recurring`, scoped to the user, which stores each template as JSON. `POST /recurring/run-now` lazily requires `recurringCron.js` and calls `runRecurring` immediately, the same code the 00:05 job runs.

sections.title: Journal, BAS, dashboard and reports
sections.explanation: The general journal, BAS quarter workflow and annual summary, dashboard totals, export account mapping, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, GST summary and chart data. These read the journal lines written by the helpers above, which is why every money-moving path posts through `createJournalEntry`.

sections.title: Sub-routers, runReport and exports
sections.explanation: Mounts sub-routers for the year-end pack, documents, statements and extra reports, passing them shared helpers by injection. `runReport` runs a report route in-process with fake request/response objects that extend EventEmitter; the comment records that plain stubs broke in production because Sentry's tracing calls `res.once`. Helpers are then attached to the router (`todayStr`, `createJournalEntry`, `gstAppliesOn`, and others) so `recurringCron.js` can reuse them.

Dockerfile.base.overview: The heavy base image holding the slow, rarely changing layers: system packages, Python libraries, Playwright Chromium and every npm install. A GitHub workflow builds it and publishes it to a container registry, so a Railway deploy never rebuilds it even when its layer cache is empty. Tour step 12 describes this split between base and app images.

sections.title: Purpose and base
sections.explanation: The comment explains where the image is built and stored and that it rebuilds automatically when this file, a package*.json or a requirements file changes. It starts from `node:20-slim`.

sections.title: System packages and Python
sections.explanation: Installs LibreOffice (document conversion), ffmpeg, qpdf (PDF password tools), poppler-utils (PDF rasterising for Contract Review OCR), fonts and Python, then clears the apt lists to keep the layer small. Root Python requirements are installed with `--break-system-packages`; the trailing `yt-dlp -U || true` means a failed self-update does not fail the build.

sections.title: Chromium and npm dependencies
sections.explanation: Playwright Chromium is installed before `COPY package*.json` on purpose, so editing package.json does not rerun the slow browser download; a second `playwright install` after `npm install` fetches the exact locked version if it differs. `npm_config_onnxruntime_node_install_cuda=skip` is set as an ENV because the CUDA download returned 404 and broke fresh installs, and there is no GPU anyway.

sections.title: Feature requirements and planner apps
sections.explanation: Copies only the requirements files for the font and PDF-redaction Python services, so those layers stay cached until the requirements change. Then installs node_modules for the four planner apps and DocCompare in parallel from their package files alone. `wait || true` means a failure here only loses the speed-up, because the build scripts install missing modules themselves.

Dockerfile.overview: The thin app image that Railway builds on each deploy. It starts from the prebuilt base image, catches up npm dependencies if needed, copies the code, runs the Vite builds and starts `server/index.js` on port 3000. Together with `Dockerfile.base` it makes up the build split described in tour step 12.

sections.title: Base image
sections.explanation: Starts `FROM` the published base image. The comment notes that if the base lags behind package.json, for example when a deploy races the base build, the `npm install` below catches up.

sections.title: Install, copy and build
sections.explanation: Copying package files and running `npm install` before `COPY . .` keeps the install layer cached when only code changes; against the prebuilt base it is usually a no-op. `npm run build` then builds the client and the sub-apps.

sections.title: Runtime
sections.explanation: Exposes port 3000, sets `NODE_ENV=production` and runs the server directly with `node` rather than through npm, so the Node process receives container stop signals itself.

railway.toml.overview: Railway's deployment configuration: install and build commands, the start command, a health check and the restart policy. Tour step 12 describes how it controls build, health checking and restarts.

sections.title: Build commands
sections.explanation: Installs dependencies including dev dependencies, which the build step needs, then runs `npm run build`. When the Dockerfile is used, the image's own steps do the equivalent work.

sections.title: Deploy, health check and restarts
sections.explanation: Starts with `npm start`, and a deploy is only considered healthy once `/api/health` responds within 60 seconds. The restart policy retries up to 3 times on failure. `NODE_ENV=production` is set as an environment variable.

nixpacks.toml.overview: A two-line Nixpacks configuration that adds system packages when the app is built with Nixpacks instead of the Dockerfile. It installs LibreOffice and fonts so document conversion works on that path too, as noted in tour step 12.

sections.title: Setup packages
sections.explanation: Adds `libreoffice`, `fontconfig` and `liberation_ttf` to the setup phase. This is a small subset of what `Dockerfile.base` installs, so features that need ffmpeg, poppler or Chromium are only covered by the Docker build.

server/services/topicResearch/cluster.js.overview: Pure TF-IDF and cosine-similarity clustering that groups articles about the same story with chained similarity.

server/services/topicResearch/collect.js.overview: Runs one Topic Research collection pass: queries every source in parallel across all query phrasings, merges results per normalised URL with per-source signals, stores articles and per-source outcomes so one failing source never stops the run.

server/services/topicResearch/draft/gene.overview: Generates a first article draft from a research brief: builds the prompt, calls the owner-chosen model, validates the JSON strictly with one retry, checks for copied wording and logs usage cost.

server/services/topicResearch/draft/mark.overview: Renders a validated draft as plain Markdown (warnings first) and builds its download filename, shared by Copy-as-Markdown and Download .md.

server/services/topicResearch/draft/prom.overview: Pure prompt builder for draft writing: composes system and user prompts from the brief only (never article text) plus a retry prompt naming validation errors.

server/services/topicResearch/draft/sche.overview: Defines the draft article shape, length presets and limits, and the strict validator every model answer must pass (fact paragraphs must cite sources, unsourced claims become gaps).

server/services/topicResearch/matchTopic.overview: Pure topic matcher: turns a topic into lower-case word stems and builds a predicate requiring every stem to appear in a feed item title or summary.

server/services/topicResearch/modelResol.overview: Resolves which model Topic Research uses for briefs, reviews and cheap checks from per-user settings or the workspace default, with no hard-coded model ids.

server/services/topicResearch/pageKind.j.overview: Classifies a page as an article or a shop page using URL patterns, JSON-LD types, HTML and text evidence, so product pages are not ranked or briefed as coverage.

server/services/topicResearch/progress.j.overview: In-memory progress store for long Topic Research actions keyed by client opId, polled by the page to show real step-by-step status.

server/services/topicResearch/relevance/.overview: Pre-brief relevance check: one small model call rates each ticked article 0-3 against the topic and returns a verdict and message so off-topic sources are flagged before paying for a brief.

server/services/topicResearch/review/gen.overview: Asks a second model for a structure verdict on a draft essay: builds prompt from brief and draft backbone, validates JSON with one retry, logs cost.

server/services/topicResearch/review/mar.overview: Renders a validated structure verdict as plain Markdown advice for the writer.

server/services/topicResearch/review/sch.overview: Defines the structure verdict shape (keep/merge/cut/reorder/add actions, missing evidence) and its strict validator.

server/services/topicResearch/runSearch..overview: Orchestrates one full topic search for both manual and watchlist runs: per-topic lock, settings, monthly spend check, source building, collection, then analysis and ranking.

server/services/topicResearch/score.js.overview: Pure ranking engine: scores articles 0-100 from six weighted signals (rank, recency, outlet, engagement, topic match, multi-source) with shop-page penalty, plus fingerprints and topic heat.

server/services/topicResearch/settings.j.overview: Validates, loads and saves the per-user Topic Research settings (site profile, feeds, budget, SERP provider, scoring weights) stored as one JSON value in the settings table.

server/services/topicResearch/sourceWeig.overview: Manages the owner's per-outlet trust weights (0-1 by domain, default 0.5): domain cleaning, validation, load/save and map conversion for the scoring outlet signal.

server/services/topicResearch/spend.js.overview: Computes this month's Topic Research spend per user and the over-budget message, centralising the month boundary and the 0-means-no-limit rule.

server/services/topicResearch/urlNormali.overview: Pure URL canonicaliser that strips tracking-only parameters so the same article found via different feeds is stored once, plus domain extraction.

server/services/vendorDocument/lineMatch.overview: Suggests which expense a vendor receipt or invoice proves by matching it to card statement lines (foreign amount, vendor name, date window) and then to expenses; suggestions only.

server/services/fonts/tests/test_structu.overview: Integration tests for structural transforms: sidebearing updates, stem thickness both ways, winding-based counter detection, kerning compilation, and contour validation flags.

server/services/fonts/transforms/__init_.overview: Empty package marker for the glyph transforms subpackage.

server/services/fonts/transforms/glyph_e.overview: Bridge between fontTools glyf coordinates and plain-point geometry, implementing composite decomposition and the four structural transforms: stem thickness, proportional width, ascender/descender extension, and counter width.

server/services/fonts/transforms/sidebea.overview: Recalculates glyph sidebearings after outline edits by preserving the original right sidebearing and deriving LSB and advance width from the new bounds.

server/services/fonts/transforms/validat.overview: Post-transform contour integrity checks that report winding flips and degenerate contours instead of crashing the pipeline.

server/routes/aiVisibility.js.overview: Express router for the AI Visibility audit feature: lists, starts (rate-limited), fetches, deletes audits and downloads reports as Markdown or PDF, plus lists configured AI assistants.

server/routes/restyle.js.overview: Express router for the CSS restyle tool: HTML upload and preparation, CSS scraping and processing, URL page loading, AI-assisted edits, and CRUD, versioning and sharing of restyle projects stored in PostgreSQL.

server/routes/webExtractor.js.overview: Express router for the web extractor: extracts content from a URL, renders it to PDF, and downloads single images or a ZIP of images.

server/services/aiVisibility/aiVisibilit.overview: Orchestrates AI Visibility audits: fetches and renders a page, checks robots.txt, schema markup and readability, runs buyer queries against search and AI assistants, scores the result and persists audits in the database as background jobs.

server/services/aiVisibility/assistants..overview: Adapters that put a question to real AI assistants (Claude with web search, Gemini with Google Search grounding, Perplexity) using per-user settings, normalising answers, citations and errors.

server/services/aiVisibility/facts.js.overview: Pure helpers that check whether known brand facts (including numbers) appear in assistant answers, producing per-fact matches and coverage.

server/services/aiVisibility/markdown.js.overview: Builds the Markdown version of an AI Visibility audit report with robots, readability, schema, search-ranking and assistant-answer sections.

server/services/aiVisibility/pdf.js.overview: Renders an AI Visibility Markdown report into a PDF buffer with a minimal word-wrapping layout builder and page footers.

server/services/aiVisibility/queryAnalys.overview: Generates buyer questions for a brand and checks each one two ways: live web search ranking and answers from real AI assistants, detecting whether the brand is named or cited.

server/services/aiVisibility/render.js.overview: Renders a page in a shared headless browser with JavaScript enabled for the audit, guarding every request with SSRF checks, enforcing a time budget and closing the browser when idle.

server/services/aiVisibility/robots.js.overview: Parses robots.txt and determines whether known AI crawlers are allowed to fetch a given path, following agent and path-matching precedence rules.

server/services/aiVisibility/schema.js.overview: Extracts JSON-LD structured data from HTML and validates entities against required and recommended properties per schema.org type, producing findings and a score.

server/services/aiVisibility/scoring.js.overview: Weighted scoring for AI Visibility audits: technical, readability, discoverability and assistant scores, overall score, summary text and improvement suggestions.

server/services/brandFromUrl/brandRoles..overview: Pure helpers that turn colours, fonts and radii observed on a page into brand roles: contrast math, picking primary/accent/dark colours, radius steps and font family matching.

server/services/brandFromUrl/index.js.overview: Opens a public page in a guarded headless browser to propose a brand (colour roles, heading/body fonts with font files, corner radius and logo candidates) without saving anything.

server/services/brandFromUrl/pageScript..overview: In-page script evaluated in the browser that collects painted colours, fonts, radii and logo candidates from the DOM for brand extraction.

server/services/browserAgent/browserAgen.overview: Per-WebSocket browser agent session driving a Playwright browser through an Anthropic tool-use loop, with screencasting, takeover/pause controls, cost tracking and a stop-before-send guard against form submissions.

server/services/htmlFetch.js.overview: Shared HTML fetching layer with SSRF checks, redirect and cookie handling, alternate host retries and text-only fallbacks (Serper, WordPress REST API, Jina), plus site URL discovery and HTML-to-text helpers.

server/services/restyle/cssProcessor.js.overview: Runs uploaded CSS through the PostCSS AST to normalise safe issues and flag duplicates, overridden rules and contrast problems in plain English.

server/services/restyle/cssSettings.js.overview: Summarises what a page CSS settles (colours, fonts, sizes, radii, shadows, spacing, variables, breakpoints, font files, animations) with frequency counts using PostCSS.

server/services/restyle/inlineImages.js.overview: Inlines images referenced by HTML fragments and CSS as data URIs within a byte/count budget, so the restyle preview works under a strict Content-Security-Policy.

server/services/restyle/loadFromUrl.js.overview: Loads a live page for the CSS tool: makes URLs in the HTML absolute, optionally renders it headlessly, and fetches and ranks its linked stylesheets.

server/services/restyle/pageFetch.js.overview: Fetches a real page and its style files for the CSS tool without text-only fallbacks, retrying refused requests with alternate browser identities and remembering the one that worked.

server/routes/contractReview.js.overview: Express router exposing the Contract Review REST API: contract CRUD, document upload, parties, reviews, corrections, comparisons, obligations, ICS export, Q&A, PDF report download/email and clause search.

server/services/contractReview/callModel.overview: Shared helper that calls the configured LLM, parses JSON output, retries with a larger token budget on truncation, records raw outputs and tracks cost.

server/services/contractReview/clauseCla.overview: Pipeline stage that classifies segmented contract clauses into taxonomy clause types via the LLM and detects cross-references between clauses.

server/services/contractReview/compareRe.overview: Compares two contract review versions: matches clauses by Jaccard similarity, builds word-level diffs, computes risk impact and generates LLM change summaries.

server/services/contractReview/costTrack.overview: Per-review LLM cost tracker enforcing a maximum USD ceiling, throwing CostCeilingExceededError when exceeded; also defines the LLM call timeout constant.

server/services/contractReview/coverageE.overview: Static config mapping each contract type to the clause types it is expected to contain, validated against the clause taxonomy at module load.

server/services/contractReview/coverageR.overview: Builds the coverage report (pipeline stage 11) listing expected clause types missing from a reviewed contract.

server/services/contractReview/definitio.overview: Pipeline stage extracting defined terms from a contract via the LLM, grounding each definition quote against source text before persisting.

server/services/contractReview/grounding.overview: Quote-grounding utilities that verify LLM-cited quotes exist in source text using whitespace/punctuation-tolerant regex matching and return character offsets.

server/services/contractReview/obligatio.overview: Pipeline stage extracting contractual obligations (party, deadline, recurrence) via the LLM, grounding quotes and linking lineage to obligations from prior reviews.

server/services/contractReview/partiesKe.overview: Pipeline stage extracting contract parties and key terms via the LLM, combining preamble heuristics, role-label mapping, name normalization and reconciliation with previously confirmed parties.

server/services/contractReview/prompts/v.overview: Versioned (v1) prompt templates for every LLM stage of the contract review pipeline: type detection, parties/key terms, definitions, clause classification, risk scoring, obligations and summary.

server/services/contractReview/qa.js.overview: Answers free-form user questions about a reviewed contract using the LLM over its clauses, with grounded citations and cost tracking.

server/services/contractReview/rawOutput.overview: Persists raw LLM responses per review stage for auditing and debugging.

server/services/contractReview/reportPdf.overview: Stateless pdf-lib report builder producing a Contract Review PDF (summary, parties, risks, obligations) from already-loaded contract, review and obligation objects.

server/services/contractReview/riskScori.overview: Pipeline stage scoring each classified clause for risk against the contract-type playbook via the LLM, with bounded concurrency.

server/services/contractReview/segmentat.overview: Pipeline stage 2 splitting contract text into clauses using numbered-heading heuristics with sanity checks, falling back to LLM-located boundaries or paragraph splitting.

server/services/contractReview/summaryGe.overview: Pipeline stage generating a grounded executive summary of a contract review via the LLM.

server/services/contractReview/typeDetec.overview: Pipeline stage detecting the contract type (NDA, MSA, lease, etc.) via the LLM and recording the result on the review.

server/services/contractReviewModelResol.overview: Resolves which LLM model the Contract Review agent uses from user/admin settings and the model catalog, and supplies the agent card configuration.

server/services/restyle/renderPage.js.overview: Renders JavaScript-built pages in a queued headless Playwright browser with SSRF checks on every request, optional sign-in form submission, and time/size limits.

server/services/restyle/sanitizeCss.js.overview: Cleans untrusted CSS with PostCSS before it is served on public preview links: tool-generated edits are limited to managed properties, page CSS loses @import and code-running constructs.

server/services/restyle/sanitizeHtml.js.overview: Strips scripts, event handlers and other executable content from uploaded HTML using the jsdom parser so iframe previews stay script-free.

server/services/restyle/scrapeCss.js.overview: Implements the CSS tool's download-a-page's-CSS feature: fetches a live page (optionally browser-rendered), collects linked, imported and inline stylesheets with absolute URLs, and summarises their design settings.

server/services/restyle/selfContainedPag.overview: Builds a fully self-contained copy of a fetched page for the Web Extractor's exact scrape: absolute URLs, scripts removed, stylesheets inlined in order with media wrappers, and images embedded as data URIs.

server/services/restyle/sharePage.js.overview: Assembles the public read-only preview HTML for a saved CSS-tool project, sanitizing page HTML and CSS and defining strict no-script security headers.

server/services/topicResearch/cache.js.overview: 24-hour per-user, per-source, per-topic cache for paid or rate-limited Topic Research sources, with refresh bypass and pruning of old rows.

server/services/topicResearch/extract.js.overview: Politely downloads and extracts article text for Topic Research: robots.txt checks, per-site spacing, concurrency limits, SSRF-safe fetching and a time budget, reusing the Web Extractor's article parser.

server/services/topicResearch/robots.js.overview: RFC 9309 robots.txt parser and cached checker that decides whether Topic Research may read a page, honouring agent groups, longest-match rules and Crawl-delay.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/ba.overview: Defines the common Topic Research source adapter contract and the makeItem helper that normalises raw results with clipped titles and snippets.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/br.overview: Topic Research source adapter for Brave Search results, reusing the workspace web-search key and reporting search rank signals.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/gd.overview: Topic Research source adapter for the free GDELT DOC 2.0 news index, globally throttled to avoid 429s and reporting query errors gracefully.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/ha.overview: Topic Research source adapter querying Hacker News via Algolia, keeping only link stories whose title or URL contain every topic word.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/ht.overview: Minimal HTTP client for Topic Research's fixed upstream APIs with timeouts, size caps, key-free error messages, failure results and a request throttle.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/in.overview: Builds the list of active Topic Research sources from user settings and server keys, wraps paid sources in the cache, and reports per-source status.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/re.overview: Topic Research source adapter for Reddit link posts using app-only OAuth client credentials; disabled until credentials are configured.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/rs.overview: Topic Research source adapter that downloads user-listed RSS/Atom feeds through the SSRF-safe fetcher, parses them, and keeps recent items matching all topic words.

server/services/topicResearch/sources/se.overview: Topic Research source adapter for Google results via the Serper API, supplying search rank, top stories, People also ask and related searches; key selection is gated by settings.

server/services/webExtractorPalette.js.overview: Web Extractor colour palette tool: parses a site's stylesheets, inline styles and theme colour with PostCSS, normalises and merges similar colours by delta-E, and attributes them to roles across optionally several pages.

server/services/webExtractorPdf.js.overview: Generates a styled article PDF from extracted Web Extractor text using @react-pdf components, with WinAnsi-safe text normalisation.

server/services/webExtractorService.js.overview: Core Web Extractor engine: fetches pages and images (with identity fallbacks), and extracts article text, links, tables, metadata, images and styled content, dispatched by runExtraction.

server/utils/safeFetch.js.overview: SSRF-hardened file fetcher for user-supplied URLs: resolves once and pins public IPs, blocks private and IPv6-wrapped ranges, limits ports, redirects, size and time.

server/routes/propertyScenario.js.overview: Express router for the property-scenario feature exposing about 25 endpoints: demo, LLM parse/clarify, market rates, CDR lenders and refresh, insights, scenario calculation, standalone calculators, buyer qualification and proforma, AI advice/what-if, PDF export and proforma CRUD.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/ba.overview: Curated, indicative per-bank credit-posture matrix (overtime/rental shading, HEM stance) with an engine that estimates per-bank borrowing capacity, fit tiers and a merged bank panel for lender selection.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/bo.overview: Estimates indicative borrowing power from income, expenses and existing debts using an APRA-style assessment buffer and rate floor.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/br.overview: Computes indicative bridging-loan interest cost for buy-before-sell scenarios, resolving the settlement gap from scenario dates with caveated defaults.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/bu.overview: Deterministic Australian mortgage pre-qualification engine covering serviceability (HEM, HECS, assessment rate), LVR/LMI, debt-to-income, genuine savings and First Home Guarantee eligibility, plus lender guidance.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/cg.overview: Calculates capital gains tax on property sale events, including the ATO 12-month discount test with day-accurate ownership duration.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/ea.overview: Estimates fixed-rate loan break costs on early payout, resolving remaining fixed-period months without falling back to full loan term.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/el.overview: Builds a ranked list of eligible live CDR mortgage products for a qualified buyer, computing indicative repayments per product.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/ex.overview: Standalone calculator showing interest and time saved by making extra repayments, via amortization comparisons.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/in.overview: Barrel module re-exporting stamp duty tables and all scenario-event and standalone calculation functions of the calc package.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/lo.overview: Shared loan math primitives: payment frequencies, period rates, annuity payment amount, amortization until paid, and duration/money formatting.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/of.overview: Standalone calculator estimating interest and term saved by holding a balance in a mortgage offset account.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/pr.overview: Adds rate-stress, product-fit guidance and post-settlement cashflow notes to the strict qualification result for the proforma PDF/UI.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/qu.overview: Broker file-review layer over the strict buyer-qualification result: computes structuring/timing/lender levers with risk tags and per-bank lender fit, without altering strict numbers.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/re.overview: Calculates refinance switching costs, monthly savings and break-even period, using default fee assumptions overridable by CDR data.
Standalone repayment calculator for a loan amount, rate, term and payment frequency.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/st.overview: Computes state stamp duty (with first-home concessions) and lenders mortgage insurance for a scenario buy event.

server/services/propertyScenario/calc/ta.overview: Reference data tables for stamp duty brackets by state, LMI premiums and mortgage government fees, plus rounding and bracket-duty helpers.

server/services/propertyScenario/cdr/ban.overview: Registry of Australian banks' CDR Product Reference Data base URLs and the residential mortgage product category constant.

server/services/propertyScenario/cdr/cli.overview: Low-level CDR HTTP client with x-v version negotiation, timeouts, paginated product listing and product detail fetching.

server/services/propertyScenario/cdr/ind.overview: Barrel module merging the CDR bank registry, HTTP client, normalizer and mortgage service exports.

server/services/propertyScenario/cdr/liv.overview: Manual network probe that fetches live CDR (Consumer Data Right) mortgage products from multiple banks and prints normalized lender rows and average rates.

server/services/propertyScenario/cdr/mor.overview: Fetches residential mortgage products from bank CDR product-reference APIs, normalizes them into lender rows with a TTL cache, and computes average owner-occupied rates.

server/services/propertyScenario/cdr/nor.overview: Maps CDR BankingProductDetail payloads into the Stage 6 lender row schema: picks lending rates, estimates upfront/ongoing fees, classifies special-purpose products, and selects representative products per bank.

server/services/propertyScenario/clarify.overview: Applies user answers to unresolved assumptions and missing fields on a parsed scenario (no LLM) so the Stage 4 calculator can run.

server/services/propertyScenario/constan.overview: Shared enums for the property scenario domain: event types, rate types, dependency kinds, assumption severities and Australian states.

server/services/propertyScenario/extract.overview: Deterministic regex pre-extraction of currency, percent, duration and date spans from raw scenario text, plus span-matching helpers used to ground LLM output without invention.

server/services/propertyScenario/fixture.overview: Stage 1 scenario fixtures and Stage 2 NLP ground-truth/negative cases (source texts and expected scenarios) used by tests and demo routes.

server/services/propertyScenario/groundi.overview: Anti-hallucination layer that checks LLM-parsed scenario fields against the source text and extracted spans, nulling invented values, adding assumptions, and flagging ungrounded critical fields.

server/services/propertyScenario/index.j.overview: Barrel entry point for the Property/Mortgage Scenario Agent (Stages 1-11), re-exporting data model, parsing, grounding, calculators, orchestration, CDR, insights, presentation and API wrappers.

server/services/propertyScenario/insight.overview: Manual network probe that fetches real CDR product documents and optionally asks one LLM-backed insight question against them.

server/services/propertyScenario/mockLen.overview: Static mock lender/product rate table for the Stage 6 UI lender comparison, with stable ids for chart stubs until live feeds are used.

server/services/propertyScenario/orchest.overview: Stage 4 scenario orchestrator that walks ordered sell/buy/refinance/switch/payout events, runs calculators (CGT, stamp duty/LMI, bridging, break-even, early payout), resolves deposit dependencies and builds a cash-flow ledger with totals.

server/services/propertyScenario/parsePr.overview: System prompt, few-shot examples and prompt builder for the LLM scenario parser, injecting pre-extracted spans and constants.

server/services/propertyScenario/parseSc.overview: Stage 2 NLP parser: calls the LLM with span-annotated prompts, parses JSON, normalizes and grounds the scenario, validates it, and builds clarifying questions; logs usage.

server/services/propertyScenario/present.overview: Builds UI presentation payloads from calculation results: advice, summary tables, lender comparisons, cost/amortization/break-even chart series, calculator snapshots and funding alerts.

server/services/propertyScenario/runPipe.overview: Thin pipeline that runs text -> parse -> validate -> clarify-gating -> orchestrate, or runs directly from a structured scenario.

server/services/propertyScenario/scenari.overview: Stage 1 property scenario data model factories (scenario and loan snapshot) with ordered-event helper and re-exported enums.

server/services/propertyScenario/validat.overview: Structural and semantic scenario validator that checks loans and each event type, tracks a property ownership ledger, and returns errors/warnings or throws.

server/services/propertyScenario/whatIf..overview: Stage 12 "What if..." feature: asks an LLM to mutate editable scenario fields from a natural-language prompt, then re-runs the pipeline and presentation.

server/services/propertyScenario/wireApi.overview: HTTP-facing wrappers for /parse and /clarify that run the pipeline, build clarifying forms with field metadata, and attach presentation payloads, keeping routes thin and mockable.

server/services/propertyScenarioPdf.js.overview: Server-side pdf-lib renderer producing the property scenario report PDF (inputs, refinance/CGT results, summary, timeline, bank panels, lenders, calculators, follow-ups), mirroring the client JSX report.

client/src/pages/GuitarPage.jsx.overview: Main Guitar tool page: song library (Ultimate Guitar import, upload, manual entry), chord chart player with YouTube/audio playback, transpose and capo, loops, voicing browser, practice logging, and tabs hosting every guitar trainer and the tutor chat.

client/src/pages/guitar/BandPanel.jsx.overview: Controls for the backing band (drums, bass, volume) and the chord loop the bass follows, built from a stock progression in a chosen key or from one of the user's songs.

client/src/pages/guitar/BarreLadder.jsx.overview: Barre chord ladder trainer: five rungs from a two-string partial barre to sliding a full barre, cleared by timed clean holds that are saved to the server.

client/src/pages/guitar/ChordDiagram.jsx.overview: Pure SVG chord-shape diagram that draws frets, finger dots, muted/open strings and rings for notes held into the next chord.

client/src/pages/guitar/CoachView.jsx.overview: Coach tab that builds a practice session plan computed in code from the user's practice data, with AI only supplying the wording.

client/src/pages/guitar/ExplainDialog.js.overview: Dialog that requests an AI-written theory breakdown and practice suggestions for a song from its chord chart.

client/src/pages/guitar/FingerMoves.jsx.overview: Shows finger movement instructions for each chord change in a loop, with paired chord diagrams, a count line and tips.

client/src/pages/guitar/FingerpickLadder.overview: Fingerpicking ladder trainer with six steps from thumb-only to Travis picking, rendering timed tab that lights up with a click; progress kept in localStorage.

client/src/pages/guitar/GapClick.jsx.overview: Gap-click timing trainer: a metronome that goes silent while the player keeps tapping, grading tempo drift via gapTiming; progress stored locally.

client/src/pages/guitar/GigMode.jsx.overview: Full-screen performance mode that auto-advances a large chord chart at song tempo or steps via keyboard, foot pedals and page turners, across a song queue or set list.

client/src/pages/guitar/GlossaryList.jsx.overview: Searchable list of all guitar glossary terms with explanations and drawings.

client/src/pages/guitar/GlossaryTerm.jsx.overview: Glossary UI primitives: an inline tappable term with a popover explanation and diagram, SVG drawings for non-chord terms, and a helper that links glossary words inside a sentence.

client/src/pages/guitar/MajorMinorPairs..overview: Major/minor pair drill launcher (E/Em, A/Am, D/Dm) showing both shapes, the one note that changes, audio playback and a button to start the drill.

client/src/pages/guitar/SimplifyPanel.js.overview: Make-it-easier panel that shows the chart re-fingered via capo only or with hard chords swapped for easy ones, explaining sound changes.

client/src/pages/guitar/SingAlong.jsx.overview: Vocal range fitter: user picks lowest/highest comfortable notes and the panel suggests a key for the open song and offers to transpose to it.

client/src/pages/guitar/StrumTrainer.jsx.overview: Strumming trainer with beat-synced arrows scheduled on the audio clock, a pattern ladder, and an optional drum and bass backing band.

client/src/pages/guitar/TempoTrainer.jsx.overview: Tempo trainer for the active loop: slows playback, ramps speed after clean passes, counts in with a WebAudio click, and charts daily best speeds.

client/src/pages/guitar/TheoryPanel.jsx.overview: Panel showing the song's estimated key, Roman numeral analysis of each chord and capo suggestions, with a manual key override.

client/src/pages/guitar/TransitionDrills.overview: Drills tab ranking the user's weakest chord changes and running one-minute transition drills with saved scores, plus barre ladder, major/minor pairs and finger moves.

client/src/pages/guitar/band.mjs.overview: Pure rules for the backing band: an eight-slot 4/4 grid, drum and bass styles, and builders that turn chords, songs or library progressions into a chord loop.

client/src/pages/guitar/bandSound.js.overview: Synthesizes backing band sounds (kick, snare, hi-hat, bass) with the Web Audio API from sine waves, noise and filtered saw waves, scheduled on the audio clock.

client/src/pages/guitar/barreStages.mjs.overview: Defines the barre chord learning ladder: staged shapes from a two-string barre up to full F, B flat and sliding shapes, with hold-time clearing rules.

client/src/pages/guitar/chordSound.js.overview: Shared Web Audio helpers that play chords as soft triangle-wave strums, root notes, single MIDI tones and plucks for the chord chart and ear training.

client/src/pages/guitar/coachRoute.mjs.overview: Turns a chord change into a three-stage practice route using a real progression that contains both chords, splitting the practice block minutes across stages.

client/src/pages/guitar/fingering.mjs.overview: Standard chord fingerings (open or movable barre shapes) and a plain-language describer of which fingers stay, move or lift when changing between two chords.

client/src/pages/guitar/gapTiming.mjs.overview: Pure logic for the gap-click drill: levels, audible/silent beat scheduling, and grading of player taps for steadiness, rushing or dragging during silent beats.

client/src/pages/guitar/gigPlay.mjs.overview: Gig mode rules: font steps, BPM clamping, chart grouping for the stage and keyboard action mapping.

client/src/pages/guitar/glossary.mjs.overview: Guitar glossary data with plain two-line definitions and optional diagrams, plus lookup, in-sentence term detection and search helpers.

client/src/pages/guitar/guitarTips.mjs.overview: Catalogue of one-sentence hover tips for every control on the Guitar page, used with the shared Tooltip and validated by a test.

client/src/pages/guitar/guitarTools.mjs.overview: Describes the Guitar page tools, tab groups, help text and the controls the guide can point at; ids must match the server-side guitar tutor catalogue.

client/src/pages/guitar/pairs.mjs.overview: Major/minor chord pair drill data: open chords whose shapes differ only in the third, with a helper that finds the changing note.

client/src/pages/guitar/pickPatterns.mjs.overview: Fingerpicking ladder: role-based picking patterns on the eight-slot grid, chord string location, tab rendering and picking-finger descriptions.

client/src/pages/guitar/progressions.mjs.overview: Finds keys shared by two chords and suggests well-known progressions linking them, with explanations and practice-history summaries for chord pairs.

client/src/pages/guitar/simplify.mjs.overview: Auto-simplify logic that makes a song easier via capo placement only or capo plus easier chord substitutions, and thins dense chord changes.

client/src/pages/guitar/singRange.mjs.overview: Sing-along key finder that checks a vocal range and suggests a transposition so an assumed typical melody fits the singer comfortably.

client/src/pages/guitar/strumming.mjs.overview: Strumming patterns on the eight-slot grid with validation, a pattern ladder, slot timing (including swing) and plain-word descriptions.

client/src/pages/guitar/theory.mjs.overview: Core guitar theory library: note names, key parsing, Roman numeral analysis, key estimation and the capo optimiser used across guitar features.

client/src/pages/guitar/trainerRules.mjs.overview: Tempo trainer rules: speed clamping and adjustment after clean or messy passes, beat timing, daily bests and progress lines.

server/routes/documentRedaction.js.overview: Express router for the document-redaction workflow: upload/propose, job listing and deletion, candidate review (patch, bulk, add, resuggest), apply, preview substitution, compare, coherence, leftover fixing, frontier approval/analysis, final approval and gated artifact download.

server/services/contractReview/smokeSet/.overview: Builds the six Contract Review Stage 2 smoke-set fixtures (typed, scanned, mixed PDFs and DOCX) as deterministic in-memory buffers at test time using pdf-lib, rendered PNG scans and the redaction ingest DOCX builder.
Synthetic contract texts for the Contract Review smoke set (unnumbered, deep nesting, multi-party, amendment, scanned and mixed sources), authored independently of obligation-extraction code.

server/services/documentRedaction/applyD.overview: Applies text replacements into a .docx via JSZip by rewriting paragraph-level runs using IR paragraph locations, then scrubs document metadata.

server/services/documentRedaction/applyG.overview: Pre-apply gate that blocks redaction apply while high-score candidates remain pending, and filters candidates by local or frontier pass.

server/services/documentRedaction/applyS.overview: Shared apply pipeline for approved redactions: resolves substitution strategy, generates or reuses synthetic replacements, rewrites the DOCX for local or frontier passes, merges the entity map and exports a sanitized PDF.

server/services/documentRedaction/bankLe.overview: Lexicon of Australian and common lender names with alias regexes for deterministic bank-name redaction candidates, plus brief-intent summarisation.

server/services/documentRedaction/catego.overview: Canonical redaction category labels and aliases that normalise free-form LLM category output so HITL filters stay consistent.

server/services/documentRedaction/compar.overview: Side-by-side compare and HITL frontier approval gate: builds highlight payloads, scans leftover real values, runs a local-model coherence check, retries PDF conversion, fixes leftovers and approves jobs for frontier analysis.

server/services/documentRedaction/docxPa.overview: Parses .docx OOXML into a location-aware paragraph/run IR and provides occurrence-finding helpers so candidates map back to precise locations.

server/services/documentRedaction/entity.overview: Opt-in per-user cross-job dictionary keeping synthetic replacement values consistent, keyed by a hash rather than storing real values in plaintext.

server/services/documentRedaction/export.overview: Shared download gate for redaction artifacts, serving only redacted DOCX, sanitized PDF and the final-approved audit trail, never internal entity maps.

server/services/documentRedaction/finalA.overview: Final HITL approval step that re-scans the redacted DOCX for leftovers, records approval and exports the internal-only audit trail.

server/services/documentRedaction/fronti.overview: Runs frontier-model residual-risk analysis on the sanitized PDF only, guarding outgoing payloads against real entities and mapping suggestions back into redaction candidates.
Calls the configured frontier model with an optional PDF attachment, falling back to text-only callModel, and normalises token usage.
Tolerant JSON parser for frontier-model responses that strips markdown fences.
Hard safety net rejecting any outgoing frontier payload that still contains a known real entity value from the job entity map.

server/services/documentRedaction/ingest.overview: Normalises uploaded documents (DOC, ODT, RTF, PDF, TXT, HTML, etc.) into .docx for the redaction pipeline via LibreOffice, PDF-to-Word or a minimal OOXML builder.

server/services/documentRedaction/jobSto.overview: Filesystem-backed store for redaction jobs: per-user job directories, artifact save/load, internal-only entity map and audit log, export path allow-listing, listing and deletion.

server/services/documentRedaction/llmCan.overview: Uses the configured LLM via callModel to propose sensitive-entity redaction candidates from chunked DOCX paragraphs, parsing JSON replies and resolving them to document locations.

server/services/documentRedaction/mergeC.overview: Merges and deduplicates redaction candidates from LLM and pattern sources by normalized entity key, using the bank lexicon to unify aliases, expand occurrences and compute composite scores.

server/services/documentRedaction/metada.overview: Scrubs identifying OOXML metadata (core/app props, comments, people, custom XML) from a JSZip DOCX and handles tracked changes fail-closed unless explicitly accepted.

server/services/documentRedaction/patter.overview: Deterministic regex backstop that detects well-known PII and figure shapes (emails, phones, IDs, currency, percentages) as redaction candidates alongside the LLM.

server/services/documentRedaction/pdfExp.overview: Exports a redacted DOCX to a sanitized PDF via LibreOffice and strips identifying PDF metadata.

server/services/documentRedaction/previe.overview: Generates a heuristic-only before/after sample preview for a chosen substitution target without writing DOCX or PDF, supporting cancellation.

server/services/documentRedaction/propos.overview: Milestone 1 orchestrator that ingests a document, runs the local LLM and pattern detectors, then merges and expands candidates and persists them to the job.

server/services/documentRedaction/review.overview: Human-in-the-loop review operations for redaction jobs: per-candidate decisions, bulk decisions by pattern, user-added candidates and feedback-guided extra LLM suggestions, all persisted with the job.

server/services/documentRedaction/substi.overview: Orthogonal constraint that, under the realistic strategy, regenerates linked money figures (income, expenses, surplus, capacity) so fabricated values stay arithmetically consistent.
Substitution strategy registry and entry point that resolves a target into a strategy plan, generates replacements and applies the arithmetic-consistency constraint.
Blackout substitution strategy replacing entities with category-based opaque tokens.
Generalized substitution strategy that replaces values with coarse buckets (currency ranges, percent bands, generic person/org/bank labels).
Default realistic substitution strategy that asks the LLM for plausible synthetic values, with a heuristic fallback and format validation/repair.
Defines the substitution target contract (consumer + requirement), UI style mappings, defaults and resolution into a strategy plan.

server/services/documentRedaction/synthe.overview: Backward-compatible facade over the substitution module exposing synthetic replacement generation and strategy constants.

server/services/documentRedaction/valida.overview: Validators and generators for Australian identifiers and formats (ABN checksum, email, AU phone, DMY date) used to repair synthetic replacements.

server/services/officeConvert.js.overview: Shared LibreOffice/soffice conversion helper used by PDF Tools and Document Redaction, locating the binary and converting buffers via a temp directory.

server/services/pdfToWord/index.js.overview: Converts PDF to DOCX by invoking the Python pdf2docx script, used by PDF Tools and Document Redaction PDF intake.

server/services/shelfRedact.js.overview: Vault Shelf sensitive-text scanner that reuses Document Redaction patterns plus checksum-validated TFN, BSB/account and Luhn card rules, returning finding offsets only with no model, storage or logging.

server/middleware/ffmpegRoute.js.overview: Express wrapper for ffmpeg-backed routes shared by Video Tools and Music: returns 503 without ffmpeg, enforces the global video job concurrency gate, logs errors uniformly, and raises a Suggestions-inbox alert on ffmpeg timeouts.

server/routes/music.js.overview: Express router for the Music feature: AI mood suggestion and tutor, music generation jobs (upload video or track, generate/regenerate options, refit), scene cuts, voiceover upload, mixed previews/exports and saving results to the video library.

server/routes/videos.js.overview: Large Express router for Video Tools: library CRUD and streaming, AI video generation, clip/join/reframe/convert, captions and transcription, script timing, voice isolation, swear removal, animated titles/captions, intro/ending, section replacement, TTS and audio mixing, plus background job polling.

server/services/animatedCaptions.js.overview: Builds word-by-word animated captions from SRT cues: estimates per-word timings, renders each caption state as a transparent PNG via headless Chromium, and overlays the image sequence on the video with ffmpeg, optionally using Brand Kit colours/fonts.

server/services/animatedTitle.js.overview: Generates animated title screens (headline, supporting line, logo) as MP4s or as overlays on an existing video by building escaped HTML pages rendered through htmlVideoRender, with colours, logo and fonts from the server-side Brand Kit.

server/services/audioMix.js.overview: Mixes a foreground voice with background music into one loudness-normalised audio file, reusing Music-page looping/crossfade and ducking presets; the filter builder is pure for testing.

server/services/cleanLanguage.js.overview: Swear-word removal for media and transcripts: transcribes speech word by word through Replicate Whisper models (trying several in order), then bleeps or silences each word with ffmpeg, or masks/replaces words in text and SRT transcripts.

server/services/extendEnding.js.overview: Intro and ending tool: holds the first and last frames of a video while the music continues and fades out, building a single ffmpeg pass that also lays on opening/closing titles.

server/services/googleFonts.js.overview: Downloads Google Fonts as real TrueType/OpenType bytes (trying several user agents and rejecting non-SFNT formats) with in-memory caching, and writes them to a directory for ffmpeg text rendering.

server/services/graphicsBrandKit.js.overview: Persistence layer for the per-user Graphics Brand Kit: merges website-derived brand proposals into the kit JSON in settings and stores heading/body font files in a separate table, all inside a database transaction.

server/services/htmlVideoRender.js.overview: Renders server-built HTML pages with paused Web Animations into MP4 (or per-state PNGs) by seeking headless Chromium frame by frame and piping screenshots into ffmpeg, with all network requests blocked.

server/services/music/musicFit.js.overview: Fits a generated music clip to a video length via equal-power crossfade looping and fades, detects scene cuts, and mixes music (with optional voiceover ducking) into the video; filter builders are pure and unit-tested.

server/services/music/musicJobs.js.overview: In-memory, TTL-based job store for music generation: each job owns a temp directory with the uploaded video and fitted option WAVs; handles creation, per-option generation, regeneration, refitting, uploaded tracks and sweeping orphaned directories.

server/services/music/musicPrompts.js.overview: Pure mapping from mood presets to MusicGen prompt text, including BPM parsing and an instrumental-only suffix.

server/services/music/musicProviders.js.overview: Music generation backends behind one provider interface: Meta MusicGen via the Replicate API (version resolution, polling, safe audio download) and a fake ffmpeg synth provider for dev/test.

server/services/music/voiceProviders.js.overview: One-line shim re-exporting the shared voice providers module into the music services folder.

server/services/replaceSection.js.overview: Replaces the picture of one stretch of a video with an equal-length clip while copying the soundtrack untouched, with xfade transitions inside the section; planning and filter graph building are pure.

server/services/scriptTiming.js.overview: Turns an untimed written script into SRT captions by splitting it into caption lines and aligning them to a timed transcript, falling back to explicit time markers or length-weighted timing; pure with no I/O.

server/services/srtUtils.js.overview: Minimal SRT parser/normalizer that cleans Gemini's loose SRT-like caption output (code fences, missing blank lines, bad numbering) before it reaches the client or burn-captions.

server/services/titleCard.js.overview: Places a mid-video title card (headline, supporting line, button, web address over a tint) between a start and end time without changing video length or audio.

server/services/videoBackgroundJobs.js.overview: In-memory background job runner for long Video Tools encodes so requests return immediately with a job id; supports polling, cancellation, TTL pruning and one active job per user.

server/services/videoCleanup.js.overview: Video clean-up recipes built on ffmpeg: HDR-to-SDR tonemapping, silence removal, stabilisation, denoising, logo removal and keyframe-aware smart cuts, with filter capability detection.

server/services/videoEndCard.js.overview: Builds intro, closing and windowed title/end cards for videos: normalizes card options, lays out text, generates drawtext/overlay filter graphs and appends or overlays the card via ffmpeg.

server/services/videoFfmpeg.js.overview: Core ffmpeg/ffprobe toolkit for the video platform: probing, clipping, converting, joining with crossfades, reframing, speed changes, audio trim/loudness, slideshows, GIFs, subtitles and drawtext annotations.

server/services/videoJobGate.js.overview: Global concurrency limiter for heavy ffmpeg jobs with a bounded wait queue that rejects with a busy error past capacity; exports a shared singleton gate.

server/services/videoJoin/capabilities.j.overview: Serializes the clip-effect and transition registries to plain JSON for the Join UI capabilities endpoint, keeping UI, validation and AI planner in sync.

server/services/videoJoin/clipEffects.js.overview: Registry of per-clip Join effects, each declaring parameters and a build() producing ffmpeg video/audio filter fragments; drives validation, prepare stage and planner descriptions.

server/services/videoJoin/joinClips.js.overview: Orchestrates joining videos with per-clip effects and per-join transitions, choosing between the plain concat path, prepared stream-copy concat, or a full filter_complex graph.

server/services/videoJoin/joinGraph.js.overview: Pure builder for the ffmpeg filter_complex that joins prepared clips, planning timings and handling cut, overlap (xfade) and dip transitions by kind.

server/services/videoJoin/schema.js.overview: Tiny parameter-schema helpers (num, oneOf, bool) used by effect and transition registries for validation/clamping and planner prompt text.

server/services/videoJoin/transitions.js.overview: Registry of Join transitions (cut, overlap, dip) with parameter declarations, easing curves, normalization and planner descriptions.

server/services/videoLibraryService.js.overview: Per-user video asset library backed by PostgreSQL and the upload directory: save, list, get, rename, delete assets with quota and usage tracking.

server/services/videoUrlIntake.js.overview: Streams a licensed direct video file URL to disk for the clip pipeline, deliberately blocking platform hosts like YouTube/Vimeo/TikTok.

server/services/voiceIsolation.js.overview: Separates voice from background music via Demucs on Replicate (AI mode) or an ffmpeg-only quick filter chain, with stem selection and result caching.

server/services/voiceProviders.js.overview: Text-to-speech provider abstraction with Gemini, Replicate and fake backends behind a speak/describe interface, plus voice, speed and provider selection.

server/services/voiceover.js.overview: Turns a script into a 44.1 kHz stereo speech WAV using the configured voice provider, for Video Tools Mix audio.

client/src/pages/PasswordVaultPage.jsx.overview: Top-level Password Vault page that wires the sidebar of vault tools (passwords, generator, health, master password), the guided tour, the tutor chat and the useVault hook into one workspace screen.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/EntryForm.overview: Form for adding or editing an encrypted vault login entry (title, username, password, URL, notes, client link) with voice input and an inline password generator.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/Generator.overview: Dialog wrapper that opens the password generator panel from an entry form so a generated password can be dropped into the entry.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/HealthToo.overview: Password health tool view that runs checkHealth over decrypted entries and lists reused, weak, old or missing passwords, behind the unlock gate.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/MasterToo.overview: Master password and lock tool: change the master password (re-encrypting entries), erase the vault, lock it, and choose the auto-lock timeout.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/Passwords.overview: Main My passwords tool: searchable list of decrypted entries with detail view, copy actions, client linking, edit and delete with undo, behind the unlock gate.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/UnlockGat.overview: Gate component that shows a setup form for a new master password or an unlock form for an existing vault before rendering protected vault content.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/passwordV.overview: Static catalogue of Password Vault tools, groups, hover tips, blurbs and guide targets, kept in sync with the server-side tutor catalogue.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/useVault..overview: React hook holding all Password Vault state and actions: loads key settings and encrypted rows, decrypts in the browser, and saves, updates and deletes entries as ciphertext via the API.

client/src/pages/passwordVault/vaultHeal.overview: Browser-only password health checker that flags reused, weak, old and missing passwords across decrypted entries, ranked worst first.

client/src/store/passwordVaultStore.js.overview: Zustand store holding the in-memory, non-extractable vault key and lock state, with an activity-based auto-lock timer and a remembered auto-lock preference.

client/src/utils/passwordGen.mjs.overview: Cryptographically random password generator with option normalisation, entropy calculation and a strength estimator used by the generator and health check.

client/src/utils/tours/passwordVaultTour.overview: Guided onboarding tour for the Password Vault page, defining step-by-step highlights of its tools with a step counter and safe step transitions.

client/src/pages/TopicResearchPage.jsx.overview: Top-level Topic Research page that orchestrates topic search, saved/watched topics, history, settings, briefs and drafts across three tabs, with guided tour, tutor chat and undoable deletes.

client/src/pages/topicResearch/ActionBar.overview: Small presentational helpers for the Topic Research views: an action bar, an action row and an overflow more-menu.

client/src/pages/topicResearch/BriefTabs.overview: Tab strip for switching between multiple research briefs on a topic, labelling each brief and loading it via the API.

client/src/pages/topicResearch/topicRese.overview: Static catalogue of the Topic Research page's tabs, groups, tips, blurbs and guide tool entries consumed by the page and its tutor guide.

client/src/utils/tours/topicResearchTour.overview: Shepherd.js guided tour for the Topic Research page with a step counter and safe step guards.

server/services/codeMap/briefing/sources.overview: Loads the curated briefing sources (about, rules, building-blocks markdown) and detects when rules.md is stale relative to its source files via content hashes.

server/services/codeMap/findings.js.overview: Code Map stage 11: generates the ranked findings list from rule results, cross-tool import cycles, cron routes and housekeeping structure data.

server/services/codeMap/imports.js.overview: Code Map stage 2: builds the relative-import graph between files (with aliases) and offers BFS reachability over it.

server/services/codeMap/index.js.overview: Entry point of the Code Map analyzer: orchestrates all stages (files, imports, tools, mounts, ownership, rules, structure, security, findings) into one result with no model, network or database calls.

server/services/codeMap/mounts.js.overview: Code Map stage 5: parses API router mounts in server/index.js and maps API paths to mounts.

server/services/codeMap/rules.js.overview: Code Map stage 8: declarative convention checks (model resolution, raw fetch, icons, console use, docs, etc.), each returning pass/warn/fail/na with evidence lines.

server/services/codeMap/run.js.overview: Command-line runner for the Code Map analyzer that prints a summary and optionally writes the full JSON result.

server/services/codeMap/structure.js.overview: Code Map stage 9: whole-codebase structure analysis covering import cycles, largest files, fan-in, possibly unused files, backups and separate packages.

server/services/codeMap/tools.js.overview: Code Map stage 3: extracts tools from the navigation catalog and attaches their client entry pages parsed from App.jsx routes.

server/services/codeMap/worker.js.overview: Runs the synchronous Code Map analysis in a worker thread so the main server thread stays responsive, reporting stage progress.

client/src/pages/domains/BriefForm.jsx.overview: Step 1 form for the naming brief (description, styles, tone sliders, required endings and social platforms) with voice input on text fields and suggestions of names the person already has.

client/src/pages/domains/DomainsTutorCha.overview: Thin wrapper configuring the shared TutorChat component as the Domain guide, supplying endpoint, wording, starters and verdict styles.

server/routes/guitarPlay.js.overview: Express router mounted at /api/guitar-play serving set lists for gig mode, known chords and "what can I play" roadmaps, milestones and tips, ear training sessions and barre chord ladder holds, all scoped to the caller.
